chain.text: Mont Ventoux observatory runs a 60-cm reflector (2017) and a 20-cm outreach refractor, averaging 195 useful nights yearly (168 in 2024). Monthly data (~400 GB) transfers nightly to Marseille in 40 minutes. A new main camera (March 2025) has 30% lower read noise but needs an unapplied firmware update requiring one offline night. Past incidents: a 2023 dome-motor seizure bent a counterweight rod (replaced, limit switch added); a February 2025 clock offset lost three weeks of photometry (GPS checks now standard). Rules: no observing during outreach evenings, raw frames compressed only after two years, and software changes need a test night. A proposed Spanish collaboration awaits evaluation of its shared scheduling tool and network capacity.
